architecture: Retain local N1 SMO/PLL equations and N2 removable layout. Calibrate filtered measurements, extrapolate channel aperture ages using past samples. No unstable inverse filter; no true rotor/current/terminal-voltage inputs.
uncertainty: Integrate floating/diode sign ambiguity over native intervals. Current sign comes from a causal RL predictor anchored to past calibrated samples. Include a declared 0.25 A engineering sign-uncertainty band; this is a stress allowance, not a proven hardware bound. Report uncertainty separately; do not remove zero-crossing samples to improve statistics.
